plan.title: Save vendor selection in eRFX draft

steps.note: Open the Events list to locate the saved draft.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Apply the tenant configuration required for vendor selection behavior.
Apply the additional configuration specified for the draft scenario.
Confirm the events list rendered successfully.
Open a saved draft, as the case does not provide a draft title.
Open the draft's participant selection area and All Vendors window.
Select the specified vendor checkbox and confirm its enabled state.
Check whether the All Vendors window closes after saving.
Check that the selected vendor is still represented on the saved draft screen.
